moods.label: Outdoors
moods.blurb: Two parks, then a cafe. All three are on Hong Kong Island.

stops.reason: Start outside on the Causeway Bay lawns. Picked because this mood asks for a park, not because of a score.
Stay outdoors in the shade at Admiralty. A short MTR ride from Causeway Bay, not a walking loop.
Sit down in Sheung Wan after the parks. This cafe is only a local catalog entry, not a partner venue.

moods.label: Museums
moods.blurb: Three public museums in Kowloon. Allow travel time between Tsim Sha Tsui and West Kowloon.

stops.reason: Open the day at the harbourfront art museum. Local catalog pick for a museums mood.
Stay in Tsim Sha Tsui for the history museum, a walk from the art museum rather than a new district.
End at M+ in West Kowloon. This is a second district, so leave time on the MTR. Hours are not checked.

moods.label: A film
moods.blurb: A Kowloon afternoon that leaves room for one screening. Showtimes are not looked up.

stops.reason: Begin in Kowloon Park so the day is not only indoors. Catalog pick, not a ranked suggestion.
The art museum is a walk towards the harbour from the park, before the cinema.
Leave the afternoon for one film at Broadway Cinematheque in Yau Ma Tei. No showtimes are fetched.

moods.label: Quiet
moods.blurb: A smaller park-and-tea morning in Admiralty, then a cafe in Sheung Wan.

stops.reason: Hong Kong Park is the quiet outdoor start: ponds and shade rather than a large lawn.
Flagstaff House is inside the same park, so the second stop does not add a journey.
Move to a Sheung Wan cafe to sit and read. Hand-listed only. Not a measured match.
